headline: Iranians Lash Out Again: "We Are the Masters of Hormuz"
summary: A former IRGC commander said Iran is introducing its own naval blockade, with Iranian officials declaring control of the Strait of Hormuz. The claim adds to ongoing tensions with the US.
why: The Strait of Hormuz is a key chokepoint through which a large share of the world's seaborne oil passes, so shipping threats there move energy markets.
why_moved: A claimed naval blockade in the Strait of Hormuz threatens oil shipments through a key chokepoint.
